objective: Test whether the reusable v4 acceptance path can retain all sealed raw rows and prove typed-Parquet value/type/order round trip with bounded memory and without repeating per-row source hashing.
necessaryAcceptance: bind the paused seal and prior offline necessary structural PASS
replay the complete measured-root sealed inventory exactly once
scan every raw row in a bounded-memory type/profile pass
write typed Parquet in bounded batches
stream typed Parquet back and compare row count plus complete ordered canonical row digest
deliberatelyRemovedFromQualificationGate: duplicate canonical JSONL because sealed raw JSONL is already the canonical complete record
millions of recordId strings embedded in a delivery manifest
per-row re-hashing of a source file
failClosedRules: any binding, seal replay, JSON scalar/type, cardinality, digest, Parquet schema or round-trip mismatch fails
failure output is preserved and the same attempt is not retried
sealed source roots are never modified
reuseDecisionRule: Reuse the implementation in v4 only if this independent attempt passes complete sealed inventory replay and all ten table-level typed-Parquet round trips.
